description: This file defines API routes for handling payment processes via Stripe and Razorpay, including creating checkout sessions, handling webhooks, and managing user premium status.

methods.name: stripe_checkout(body: StripeCheckoutRequest, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session URL for a given price_id and user.

methods.name: stripe_webhook(request: Request, stripe_signature: Optional[str] = Header(None))
methods.description: Handles incoming Stripe webhook events to update user's premium status.

methods.name: razorpay_order(body: RazorpayOrderRequest, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a Razorpay order placeholder response for a given request.

methods.name: razorpay_webhook(request: Request, x_razorpay_signature: Optional[str] = Header(None))
methods.description: Processes Razorpay webhook events to update user's premium status.

ctags.name: razorpay_webhook
ctags.pattern: /^async def razorpay_webhook(request: Request, x_razorpay_signature: Optional[str] = Header(None))/

ctags.name: stripe_webhook
ctags.pattern: /^async def stripe_webhook(request: Request, stripe_signature: Optional[str] = Header(None)):$/
